scope: Paired development experiment, not independent accuracy or flight qualification

config.taxonomy_source: User rule clarification, 2026-10-07; independent rule-document verification not performed in this change
config.status: training configuration; generated artifacts require separate validation and are not deployment-approved

teacher_cache.preprocessing: Teacher 96x96 RGB Pillow bilinear; unit-L2 per-example feature

provenance.hint_loss: mean cosine distance, teacher features unit-L2
provenance.class_loss: 0.5 hard CE + 0.5 KL at temperature 4, multiplied by T squared
provenance.selection: minimum validation hard-label cross entropy; no development-scene selection
provenance.shuffle: numpy default_rng(seed).permutation each epoch; matched across arms
provenance.augmentation: none; teacher/student share source crop, different fixed input sizes
